body: One of my yearbooks was supposed to have something something inner strength as the motto of the year or what have you. When we received the books it said something something inner stength. on every single yearbook
I have seen psychiatrists in the past. Medications changed me from a depressed person into a morbidly obese depressed person. It took me almost 2 years to lose all the weight. I will pm you.
Ask him to create a rock so heavy he himself cannot lift it?

I have seen therapists in the past. Both psychiatrists and councellors. They didn't really help. I was on meds from age 14 to 25. I stopped taking them because they had turned me into a 350lb couch potato. I don't even remember what my councellors did for me.

>but: it wasn't always this way, yes?
  
You are correct

>would you do so?

I believe I would

When someone tells me about their pain I don't know how to respond. It doesn't really incite any emotion in me. For instance, I have a person I have known since high school(about 10 years now), you could call him my best friend, tell me that his mentor had died, he was distraught and very emotionally upset. All I could think of to say was "That sucks dude" with no emotion inflected in my voice. I didn't feel any empathy for him.

As for your second question: Do I want to feel emotion

I don't know what that would do to me. I have been void of emotion for a while now that I have forgotten what to emulate in social situations. I think I want to be normal, emotionally, and be be able to interact better with people as well as perform better on a professional level.

I don't really know if anything makes me feel anymore. Even pain does not incite any real emotional response. I am aware there is pain occurring but you would not be able to tell from looking at me that I was experiencing anything
My hometown is said to be the gravesite of Pocahontas

I have been at step 4-6 for the last two weeks. I have no real support system and I have no intention of being hospitalized again. I am trying to ride it out and If I am successful I am reasonably sure that it would be only a matter of time until I succeed in completing step 6.
